stuttgart_triptych_sem.title: Same street: semantic segmentation
stuttgart_triptych_sem.caption: Every pixel labelled in real time: road, sidewalk, people, cars, buildings, trees, sky.
stuttgart_triptych_sem.license: Cityscapes terms of use: non-commercial use only (academic research, teaching, publications, personal experimentation); https://www.cityscapes-dataset.com/license/
stuttgart_triptych_sem.model: D-FINE-seg-X, released Cityscapes sem-seg weights (dfine_sem_x_cityscapes.pt), native 1024x2048 input
stuttgart_triptych_sem.split: demo video (unlabeled sequence, not in Cityscapes train/val/test)
stuttgart_triptych_sem.notes: Cityscapes val 84.84 mIoU, 14.6 ms end-to-end (TensorRT fp16, RTX 5070 Ti, 1024x2048); test server 83.23 mIoU. Clip: stuttgart_02_clip01.mp4 from 0s, 12s, native 17 fps.

iron_belt_things_sem.title: Tools left on an iron ore conveyor
iron_belt_things_sem.caption: A hammer, a folding tool and a wooden block ride the belt with the ore: every pixel is sorted into ore, oversized rock or foreign object, at full belt speed.
iron_belt_things_sem.dataset: In-lab Image Dataset of Foreign Objects and Anomalies in Iron Ore Conveyor Belts (Sousa, de Oliveira, Coelho, Delabrida Silva; UFOP / Instituto Tecnologico Vale / Lakehead University), Mendeley Data V1, 2025, doi:10.17632/s25x2bnshz.1
iron_belt_things_sem.model: D-FINE-seg-L sem_seg, 640x640 input, fine-tuned from the Cityscapes L weights on SAM/Gemini-assisted pixel labels made from this dataset's frames
iron_belt_things_sem.split: val (video boardcamera_iron_ore_things_2.mp4 is held out from training)
iron_belt_things_sem.notes: val mIoU 0.831, pixel acc 0.982 (4 classes: background, iron, big_rock, trash). Lab-scale conveyor rig recorded at ~119 fps; shown at real-time speed (every 4th frame). Clip: boardcamera_iron_ore_things_2.mp4 from 15.0s, 8.2s.
